messages.author: 83076cc1e3bf14f2
messages.subject: Suggestion of further development
parts:
Dear Yves,

I greatly appreciate your work! lavaan is definitely a wonderful gift to the community of researchers around the world.

May I make a suggestion if this is not in the list of future development?

As we know, the usual purpose of SEM is to make sense of relationships among manifest variables (MVs) based on a theory about latent variables (LVs). In most situations, scales of variables (not only LVs but even MVs) are not of primary interest, and this is why some people who know what SEM is about want to just look at standardized parameters and their corresponding SEs and CIs. For example, RAMONA in SYSTAT, an SEM software package that people no longer use much but is otherwise technically meticulous, reports all standardized parameters *along with* their correct SEs, CIs, and test statistics.

With lavaan, this is not possible. Note that correct SEs and CIs for parameters with all variables standardized are not obtained simply by applying some formulas to fitted results. The parameterization should be different in order to obtain correct results. The idea (which is implemented in RAMONA, for example) is that equality constrains are imposed on the variances of all endogenous variables (both LVs and MVs). Of course, you cannot directly set them to 1 since they are endogenous. Instead, these constraints are imposed on the parameters influencing the endogenous variables. In the case of MVs, you need to insert sort of pseudo-LVs as indicators of each MV and estimate nuisance factor loadings to account for MVs' variances. The residual variances of MVs are set to 0, and instead, error terms are attached to these pseudo-LVs.

As far as I know, this is the only way to obtain correct SEs and CIs for fully standardized parameters.

-Jae

P.S. Not only that, the current way of standardizing endogenous LVs in lavaan make parameters around them difficult to interpret.

Yes, RAMONA is a treasure, and lavaan should adopt some of its features.
Please (re)post this as an issue on lavaan's github page.

Yves.
